findings.text: Item 13 says "✦ starts a new session", but `create()` now continues any session from the same page and project that spoke in the last hour (Servex/agents/Sessions.js:236-237), and rail.js:1389-1391 drops the "Start fresh" choice. So within an hour there is no way to start a fresh session on that page. Add a `fresh: true` flag to `/new` (or keep a "Start fresh" button) so the owner can always start over.

The screenshot does not show this change: sheet.png still shows the old caption ("one pointer line in its own page.jsonl") and has no "Recent sessions on this page" list, which page.js:1228-1229 adds. The new page was never shot, so its layout is unchecked. Take the shots again once the branch is served.

Several deliverables are not in this diff and have no proof: `Usage.pick` (item 5), the phone proof of three navigations (item 1), `ask_directory` answering a /framework/core/Page/ question from the readmes (item 8), each page's AI tab holding only the lines said there (item 11), and the task-log decision in the AITask readme (item 15). If other tasks delivered these, link them from the report.

A folder the session already visited gets `ended` when the pair sleeps, but no new `started` when the session wakes and passes through it again. `point()` returns early because `visited` already lists the folder (Sessions.js:222), and the revive at Sessions.js:390 writes `started` only in the home folder. Because the latest line wins, that folder shows the session as ended while it is live there.

`dir_of()` never checks that the folder is inside the repo (directory.js:508-517). `dir: "../.."` passes and opens a mastermind on a folder outside the repo; it is read-only, but it should be refused. `Sessions.folder()` already makes this check (Sessions.js:202), and the same check fits here.

The `directory-mastermind` row in roles.js:847 says `permission_mode: "bypassPermissions"`, but `ask()` always overrides it with `"plan"` (directory.js:668). Put `plan` in the row so the table tells the truth.

The roles page is only half-updated (roles.md:950). The Directory mastermind row still says "until a real tool exists" in its model column, and still names `page-mastermind`/`manager` as live. The Smart assistant row says it "follows the voice log and the nav log through `follow`", but sessions.md:1127 says the pair hears by direct send (decision `d-hear`). Item 6 asks for one name and one story per role.

The fast reply that is held while the owner is "speaking" keeps only the newest one (Sessions.js:439), so earlier fast replies are dropped without a trace. That is probably intended, but sessions.md should say it in one line.

Space, in sheet.png: at 1920px and 3440px, 74–82% of the screen is empty. The text column stops at about 700px, while the demo's input stretches across the whole width at 3440. The chat column (`session-demo-talk`) is empty until Start is pressed, so the two-column grid never shows. Give the chat pane a visible placeholder so the reader sees where the replies will appear.

page.js:1229 sets flex layout on the Recent list with inline `.style()` calls. A small class in the module's CSS layer would match the house style, and the new-css-class skill gives it a proper prefix.

The Recent line in the ✦ sheet (rail.js:1336-1343) mostly repeats what `start()` does on the first sentence anyway (it continues the session from the last hour). The line only matters for older sessions, so its label could say so ("from yesterday"), or the line could be shown only when the session is older than an hour.
